author: The Infographics Show
description:
Pentagon just released UFO footage public was never supposed to see. Some of these videos show objects moving in ways that shouldn’t be possible.

Pentagon UFO videos, UAP footage, alien sightings, and classified military recordings are finally being exposed through a massive declassified release containing more than 160 unexplained aerial phenomenon files.

The footage was captured by U.S. military sensors across the Middle East, Syria, Greece, Japan, the Indo-Pacific, and even the United States.
Some clips show glowing orbs, jellyfish-shaped UFOs, impossible 90-degree turns, objects vanishing mid-air, and strange craft that appear invisible to normal cameras.

Military analysts, Pentagon officials, and AARO investigators still can’t fully explain many of these encounters.
Skeptics believe some sightings could be drones, balloons, infrared distortions, missiles, or optical illusions, but other clips seem to defy normal explanations entirely, especially objects moving at extreme speed
title: 16 Most Disturbing Videos From Pentagon UFO Release
